usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Libya, currency exchange rates (US dollar average)
usdRate.note: Buy 6.4143, sell 6.4465 dinars per dollar on 29 October 2026 (the page showed an average of 6.4173 on 3 November 2026); World Bank 2025 average 5.30, so the dinar has been devalued since.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Trading Economics (Bureau of Statistics and Census Libya CPI, September 2026)
inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 16.6% year on year in September 2026 (14.3% in August), the highest since March 2023, after the dinar's devaluation; secondary source because the bureau's site (bsc.ly) shows only 2023 data. World Bank 2025 average 1.8%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: World Bank CPI 2021-2025 (about 2-5% a year); Trading Economics CPI 16.6% (Sep 2026) and its 7% forecast for 2028
inflation_projection.note: Inflation was low for years under subsidised prices but jumped after the 2025-26 devaluations, so 6% (between the pre-devaluation average and the current rate) is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Libya interest rate (Central Bank of Libya rediscount rate)
policy_rate.note: Central Bank of Libya rate 3% (latest reading October 2026, same as the previous reading); secondary source because the Central Bank publishes no policy-rate page. It has little practical effect, as banks publish no deposit or lending rates.

savings_account_rate.note: No published savings account rate was found. Libyan banks publish no interest rates; Law No. 1 of 2013 against interest-based (riba) transactions is the usual reason given, but no official page stating it was read during research or review.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found. Libyan banks publish no interest rates; Law No. 1 of 2013 against interest-based (riba) transactions is the usual reason given, but no official page stating it was read during research or review.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No published 1-year term deposit rate was found. Libyan banks publish no interest rates; Law No. 1 of 2013 against interest-based (riba) transactions is the usual reason given, but no official page stating it was read during research or review.

dps_rate.note: No monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: The latest World Bank deposit rate (FR.INR.DPST) for Libya is 2.5% for 2014, before interest was banned in banking; the Central Bank of Libya's monetary statistics publish no deposit rate.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found in Libya.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No Libyan treasury bill market was found; the Central Bank of Libya's monetary and banking statistics list no bill yields.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No Libyan government bond market was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No Libyan government bond market was found.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Libya: taxes on personal income (reviewed 31 May 2026)
tax_bank_interest.note: PwC says individuals are only taxed on employment income earned in Libya; in practice banks pay no interest.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Libya has no government savings certificate, so no tax rate applies.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: No deposit insurance scheme or coverage limit was found on the Central Bank of Libya's website.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap or typical credit card rate was found. Libyan banks publish no interest rates; Law No. 1 of 2013 against interest-based (riba) transactions is the usual reason given, but no official page stating it was read during research or review.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No active local stock market; global equities in dinar terms; LYD per USD 6.43 (Oct 2026)
equity_return_low.note: Low case: global equities disappoint and the dinar stays stable from here.

equity_return_base.sourceName: Global equity long-run return; dinar fell about 18% against the dollar in the year to Oct 2026
equity_return_base.note: No working local stock market, so the base is a global index in dinar terms, capped at the safe rate (about 1%) plus 4 points; access to foreign funds is also restricted.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Global equity long-run return plus dinar depreciation (Trading Economics USD/LYD)
equity_return_high.note: High case: global equities earn about 7% in dollars and the dinar keeps losing about 3% a year.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); dinar stable after the 2026 devaluation
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold barely gains after the 2025-26 spike and the dinar holds its new rate.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); dinar devalued in 2025 and 2026
gold_return_base.note: Base case: dollar gold rises with world inflation plus a little, and the dinar loses about 3% a year.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold price history (Trading Economics); USD/LYD up about 18% in the year to Oct 2026
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong dollar gold plus further devaluations like 2025-26.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit or treasury bill rates in Libya; Central Bank of Libya rate 3% (Trading Economics)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: cash and current deposits earn nothing.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: No interest-bearing deposits or treasury bills available to individuals
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a small profit share on Islamic investment deposits at most; no published rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Libya rediscount rate 3%
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: profit-sharing deposits paying around the central bank's 3% rediscount rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: No industry life claim settlement ratio was found; the Insurance Supervisory Authority's website refused automated access.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published term-life premium rates per LYD 1,000 of cover by age were found; life insurance is a very small market in Libya.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Public hospital care is free, but no figure for the typical out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No published private health insurance premium table per LYD 100,000 of cover was found.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Trading Economics CPI 16.6% (Sep 2026); medicines and private care largely imported
goal_inflation_health.note: Health costs depend on imported medicines and private clinics priced off the dollar, so they are assumed to rise faster than the 6% headline planning rate.

goal_inflation_education.note: Public education is free, but private school fees are assumed to rise a little faster than the 6% headline planning rate.

life_expectancy.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_expectancy.note: Men 72.7, women 77.8 (UN WPP estimate for 2026, mid-year); World Bank 2024 figure 71.1. Re-checked on georank 2026-11-03.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years computed from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 7.6 (2025, World Bank), 16.6 (2040) and 29.5 (2065, populationpyramid.net/libya/2065/).

retirement_age_default.note: The Social Security Fund's pensions page says the old-age pension age depends on the labour law, type of work and sex, without giving figures (it mentions early retirement for men at 60); no official statutory pension age could be read.

retirement_age_government.note: No official page stating the retirement age for civil servants could be read; the Social Security Fund page mentions early retirement after 20 years of service under Law No. 8 of 1985 but no normal age.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: No published deposit or treasury bill rates in Libya; Central Bank of Libya rate 3% (Trading Economics)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: savings held as cash or current deposits earn nothing.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: No interest-bearing deposit or treasury bill available to individuals
retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept near zero because there is no after-tax deposit or bill rate to rely on.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Central Bank of Libya rediscount rate 3%
retirement_return_high.note: High case: Islamic profit-sharing deposits paying around 3%.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Cash earns nothing; gold and global equity low cases 2%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a mix of cash, gold and foreign shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Gold base 7%, global equity base 5%, cash 1%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of cash, gold and (where accessible) global shares.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a gold- and equity-heavy mix with further dinar depreciation.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Libya has a basic pension (al-ma'ash al-asasi) for people without other income, mentioned on the Social Security Fund's pensions page, but its current monthly amount could not be read from an official source.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Eligibility ages and means test for the basic pension could not be read from an official source.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity for private employees could be confirmed; the Labour Relations Law (No. 12 of 2010) could not be checked.

public_pension_scheme.note: The Social Security Fund runs the compulsory pension; its pensions page says the pension is based on years of service and the average of the last 36 months' pay, with a minimum of 80% of the national minimum wage, but gives no pension age or indexation rule.

savings_account.note: No published interest rate; banks are understood to avoid interest-based products (Law No. 1 of 2013, not confirmed from an official page).

fdr_3m.note: No interest-bearing term deposit with a published rate was found; any investment deposits work on profit-sharing without a published rate.

fdr_1y.note: No interest-bearing term deposit with a published rate was found; any investment deposits work on profit-sharing without a published rate.

dps.note: No monthly recurring deposit scheme with published rates was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals was found.

tbill_91d.note: No treasury bill market was found.

tbond_5y.note: No government bond market was found.

tbond_10y.note: No government bond market was found.

equity_fund.note: No active local stock market or retail index fund was found; buying foreign funds is restricted by currency controls.

gold.note: Physical gold is widely bought as a store of value.

centralBank.name: مصرف ليبيا المركزي (Central Bank of Libya)

insuranceRegulator.name: هيئة الإشراف على التأمين (Insurance Supervisory Authority)
insuranceRegulator.note: Website refused automated access during research.

insuranceComplaints.name: هيئة الإشراف على التأمين (Insurance Supervisory Authority)

statistics.name: مصلحة الإحصاء والتعداد (Bureau of Statistics and Census)
statistics.note: The site showed only 2023 CPI data and some injected third-party content during research.
